scientific.integrity: The practical L4 loss-reference state is reduced exactly on a scalar quadratic. A finite-lock argument isolates the eventual autonomous recurrence, and a reciprocal-state limit yields the sharp inverse-linear loss constant.
limitations: Deterministic scalar convex quadratic with the SGD update direction.
Does not analyze the extra moving-average states of L4Mom or L4Adam.
The denominator-induced tail is an asymptotic small-gradient phenomenon.
No claim that the source numerical regularizer is practically harmful.

title: L4's denominator regularizer creates an exact inverse-linear loss tail
